name: Vintage-Story
description: This docker will run a Vintage-Story server. UPDATE NOTICE: The container can check on every start/restart if if you leave the version blank. CONSOLE: To connect to the console open up the terminal on the host machine type in: 'docker exec -u vintagestory -ti NAMEOFYOURCONTAINER screen -xS VintageStory' (without quotes). to exit the screen session press CTRL+A and then CTRL+D or simply close the terminal window in the first place.
